title: Heat flow row
description: One body's surface heat flow and its decomposition into tidal / radiogenic / primordial-cooling contributions (the v0.21.8 eighth cross-channel coupling surface). Required fields are the ones every row shares (body, total_heat_flow_TW, tidal_fraction, radiogenic_fraction, primordial_fraction, source_doi, source_published_date, entered_locally_at).

body.description: Canonical body name (terra, mars, io, europa, enceladus, titan).

total_heat_flow_TW.description: Total surface heat flow in TW (10^12 W) per the cited paper's energy-budget analysis.

tidal_fraction.description: Fraction of total heat flow from tidal dissipation. tidal + radiogenic + primordial should sum to ~1.

radiogenic_fraction.description: Fraction from radioactive decay of long-lived isotopes (238U, 232Th, 40K).

primordial_fraction.description: Fraction from primordial cooling / accretion + core-formation potential energy.

observation_method.description: Verbatim description of the observation / inference method for this row's heat-flow value.

precision_flag.description: Ship-readiness precision flag (the measurement's observational quality).

source_key.description: Short citation key into the module SOURCES dict (e.g., 'frizzell_2023', 'tobie_2005'). Redundant with source_doi; retained for cross-linking to the module's full citation string.

source_doi.description: DOI of the peer-reviewed paper authorising this row's heat-flow value. Required by the literature_curated adapter for per-row attestation. CrossRef-verified.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 date the cited paper was published. 'YYYY', 'YYYY-MM', or 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Curator-authored from the cited DOI's CrossRef metadata; aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:issued.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date this row was first added or last meaningfully amended. Curator-authored; aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:dateAccessioned. 2026-06-07 for the rc10 backfill (the mars + titan + io rows' citations were repaired in rc9).

source_version.description: Optional version/edition tag where it matters; null for journal papers whose DOI fully resolves the version.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — decomposition rationale, the tidal-energy-budget loop cross-references (v0.21.4 Q-factor + v0.21.6 migration), observational caveats.
